metadata.description: Claude Code plugins — skills, commands, agents, hooks, and scripts.

plugins.name: excalidraw-diagram
plugins.description: Generate Excalidraw diagrams that argue visually — concept-driven layouts, evidence artifacts, and a render-and-validate loop that catches layout defects before delivery.

plugins.name: git-bare-convert
plugins.description: Convert an existing plain `git clone` into a `.bare/` + worktrees layout in place, without re-cloning. Re-attaches the current branch as the first worktree.

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: Write Conventional Commit messages with a tight, why-focused body. Skips the verbose 50-line transcripts of the diff that LLMs default to.

plugins.name: git-worktree
plugins.description: Bootstrap and operate a bare-clone + worktree layout, so multiple branches live as sibling folders off a single repo and agents stay scoped to their own working tree.

plugins.name: disk-cleanup
plugins.description: Identify macOS disk space hogs and interactively clean them up.
